sentences.text: The articles on this desk deal with each of those in turn, and with the habits a first release needs: product decisions, requirements, estimates in ranges, a plain first stack, flags with a way back, and a view of what you shipped.

sentences.text: The articles on this desk are practical and ordered.
Ask whether the idea is a business or only a feature.
Map the alternatives your customer already uses.
Interview customers without collecting false encouragement, and test honestly.
Size the market from the bottom up.
Decide in advance what would make you stop.
Then write the problem brief, so that everything built afterwards can be checked against it.
Each piece names its public sources and says what it cannot tell you.
